svg.title: bon: transcript to transcript
svg.desc: Eight beats within one business day. A queue search turns talk into intents; the owner writes them into the spec and checks no search can change. Code and counterexample searches push verified, agreed code to trunk. Between iterations, counterexample searches on trunk look for what it gets wrong, with tests written blind, and compaction removes what is stale with the same behavior. People try it and talk again.
svg.text: one cycle · within one business day

g.text: No search can change spec or checks.
counterexample search tries to break it.
Try to break it before it is pushed.
Less that is stale. Same behavior.
Try it. Talk. The next transcript.
